book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: كل يوم، كانت تمر الفيلة تحت الشجرة.
sentences.en: Every day, the elephants passed beneath the tree.
Big herds, slow, and they did not see me.

sentences.ar: وكنت أرمي، وأصيب واحد، وأنزل، وأروح لسيدي.
sentences.en: And I shot, and hit one, and came down, and went to my master.
And he would come and take the ivory, and bury the elephant.
Two months like that.

sentences.ar: وكنت أحس إني بعمل إشي غلط، بس ما كان عندي خيار.
sentences.en: And I felt I was doing something wrong, but I had no choice.
And one day, the elephants did not pass.
Nor the next.
And on the third day, I heard the ground shaking.

sentences.ar: وشفتهم جايين، مش زي كل مرة.
sentences.en: And I saw them coming, not as every time.
Coming straight for the tree, all of them.

sentences.ar: وقدامهم فيل كبير، أكبر من الكل.
sentences.en: And at their head a huge elephant, bigger than all.

sentences.ar: وقفوا حوالي الشجرة، ورفعوا خراطيمهم، وتطلعوا فيّ.
sentences.en: They stood around the tree, raised their trunks, and looked at me.
And I understood: they knew who was killing them.

sentences.ar: الفيل الكبير لف خرطومه حول الشجرة.
sentences.en: The big elephant wound its trunk around the tree.
And pulled.

sentences.ar: الشجرة صرت، وانحنت، وطلعت من الأرض بجذورها.
sentences.en: The tree creaked, bent, and came out of the ground by its roots.

sentences.ar: ووقعت أنا معها، على ظهري، والفيلة حوالي.
sentences.en: And I fell with it, on my back, the elephants around me.
And I said: it is over.

sentences.ar: سابع رحلة، وسابع موت، وهالمرة حقيقي.
sentences.en: The seventh voyage, and the seventh death, and this time real.
And I closed my eyes.
And it did not trample me.

sentences.ar: حسيت الخرطوم بيلف حولي، على مهل، وبيرفعني.
sentences.en: I felt the trunk winding around me, slowly, lifting me.
And it set me on its back.
And it walked.
And all the elephants behind it, silent, through the forest.

sentences.ar: وأنا على ظهره، مش عارف لوين، ومش عارف ليش.
sentences.en: And I on its back, not knowing where, not knowing why.
And the porter said: where did it take you?
Sindbad said: that is tomorrow.
Tonight is finished.
